count_sorted_rows_matrix: count the number of strictly ascending or descending sorted rows in a 2D matrix
check_ascending_rows: check each row of a matrix to see if elements are in strictly ascending order
check_descending_rows: check each row of a matrix to see if elements are in strictly descending order
run_matrix_sort_test: run the test harness comparing f_filled against f_gold on sample matrix parameters
refactor_f_gold: refactor f_gold to use Python built-ins like all() instead of manual loop-based sorting checks
